title: Healthcare Subsidies for Long-Term Visit Pass Holders Married to Singapore Citizens
what_it_is: Healthcare Subsidies for Long-Term Visit Pass Holders Married to Singapore Citizens

sections.label: Healthcare subsidies for foreign spouses
sections.summary: Government differentiates benefits by citizenship status and in 2012 extended inpatient subsidies to LTVP-Plus foreign spouses at PR level.

sentences.speaker: Mdm Speaker
sentences.text: Does someone want to raise the question on his behalf?

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: This is in line with the broader Government policy of differentiating benefits by citizenship status.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Patients are extended subsidies based on their own citizenship status, and not that of their spouses.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: To support Singaporeans with foreign spouses who have not obtained permanent residence or citizenship, the Government decided in 2012, to extend healthcare subsidies for inpatient services to foreign spouses who are LTVP-Plus holders.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: They are given the same level of subsidies for inpatient services as PRs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Any proposal to further extend more Government subsidies to foreigners, who are neither PRs nor LTVP-Plus holders, would need to be carefully considered.

sections.label: LTVP and LTVP-Plus for foreign spouses
sections.summary: Foreign spouses of Singaporeans can be given LTVP or LTVP-Plus.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Foreign spouses of Singaporeans can be given LTVP or LTVP-Plus.

sections.label: Healthcare subsidy differentiation by LTVP category
sections.summary: Healthcare subsidy is part of differentiating benefits by category, so it is extended to LTVP-Plus holders but not LTVP holders.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Similar to how we differentiate the benefits for citizens, PRs, LTVP-Plus and LTVP.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: I think that is the policy decision to have these different categories of LTVP holders and the healthcare subsidy is part of this differentiation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Therefore, it is extended to LTVP-Plus holders but not to LTVP holders.
